meta.title: GRN Photo / Document Attachment: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Navigate to a GRN as a Warehouse Executive and inspect or use the GRN Photo / Document Attachment capability
Verify that attachment is refused or absent on the Growth-plan tenant
Repeat the attachment workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it succeeds
Compare the same user role and workflow across the two plan tenants
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Navigate to a GRN as a Warehouse Executive and inspect or use the GRN Photo / Document Attachment capability; Verify that attachment is refused or absent on the Growth-plan tenant; Repeat the attachment workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it succeeds; Compare the same user role and workflow across the two plan tenants

args.need: sign in as a Warehouse Executive on the Growth-plan tenant and the Enterprise-plan tenant, open a GRN, attempt to attach photos or documents on each tenant, and report whether the attachment capability is absent, refused, or succeeds
